content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Technical Assistant - Technical Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Technical Assistant - Technical recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Technical Assistant - Technical positions is 10-08-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BSc or MSc degree in Sciences to be eligible for the Technical Assistant - Technical position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Assistant - Technical post is 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month for the Technical Assistant - Technical position.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Technical Assistant - Technical post in this recruitment drive by IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/TFS_4305/2026/101.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Technical Assistant - Technical position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article. These links will direct you to the relevant pages on the IIT Kharagpur website.
